help: Run the Retail Security research pipeline (research/retail-security-2026). MONTHLY mode (--stages monthly): collect every public channel for the window from the day after the previous run (build/state.json) to today, build NEW incidents/roundups/leak listings/HIBP loads from that evidence and write build/periods/<from>_<to>/ (interactive site + PDF); --period-from/--period-to rebuild any window. ANNUAL mode (build/all): public multi-channel collection, globe geometry, evidence screenshots, dual-theme interactive site, headless browser check, 46-page PDF, verification, and a local run report under build/runs/<run-id>/. Optionally publishes the site as an artifact revision and the PDF as a file (named .pdf) and posts a summary on the task. Collectors keep the hard lines: no logins, no paywall bypass, no cart/checkout, no Tor; blocked = recorded, never worked around. Run from the repo root (tm8 tool run --cwd <repo-root> retail-security-report ...).

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Pipeline directory holding scripts/, raw/, build/ (relative to --cwd).

inputs.name: stages
inputs.description: Stage set or comma list. Sets: monthly (collect,reddit,social,period + geo,shots,site,check,pdf,verify,report for the new window), monthly-build (period + build stages from raw/ on disk), all (collect,reddit,social + annual build), build (geo,shots,site,check,pdf,verify,report), collect (collect,reddit,social,verify,report), verify (verify,report). Stages: collect reddit social period geo shots site check pdf verify report publish.

inputs.name: period_from
inputs.description: Monthly window start YYYY-MM-DD (default: day after build/state.json last_end; very first run: first_from). Needs the period stage.

inputs.name: period_to
inputs.description: Monthly window end YYYY-MM-DD (default: today UTC).

inputs.name: first_from
inputs.description: Monthly mode: start of the very first window when the ledger has no runs (so the first report covers a whole month).

inputs.name: no_llm
inputs.description: Monthly summaries rule-built even if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Claude model for monthly summaries when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (default claude-sonnet-5-5).

inputs.name: publish
inputs.description: Publish the site (artifact) and PDF (file with .pdf name) to tm8, link produces edges to --task and post a summary message.

inputs.name: artifact
inputs.description: Existing artifact id to publish a new revision of (e.g. 01a145a6-12b8-7534-813c-3df84910a49a). Empty = new artifact.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: tm8 task id to link outputs to and message (e.g. 01a1451b-7c20-7917-b15e-2aa749a9b7fe).

inputs.name: force
inputs.description: Redo globe geometry and all evidence screenshots even if present.

inputs.name: collect_minutes
inputs.description: Timeout in minutes for each collector stage.

inputs.name: pw_image
inputs.description: Playwright docker image used for screenshots, the theme check and the PDF (must already be present; never prune it).

inputs.name: browser_channel
inputs.description: Local browser for shots/check/pdf: auto (Playwright Chromium, else installed Google Chrome, else Edge) | chromium | chrome | msedge.
